author: m.kalinin
content: 100 signatures can save us 100KiB, it's a non-trivial saving when we are talking about 16 subnets. And it's about 6% of the committee participation -- i disagree that this is a little. If you have 4 aggregators, and 3 of them saves up to 100KiB each then we can get 300KiB saving in total; for 16 subnets it's 4.6MiB. And this can help a node with 50/25 bandwidth a lot. However, this approach can only work in a healthy network
